title: seat.ask output
description: Honest receipt of one governed delegation dispatched through the generic seat_ask primitive to the capability's published target seat. target_seat names the exact published target this receipt belongs to — a bounded registry SeatId carried from the dispatch, never a compiled identity constant, so one generic primitive serves every declared delegation. status is "recorded" only after the real child exists: durable delegation link, minted child token, opened session on the target seat's own declared composition, inherited accepted plan, and dispatched prompt — never a task-recorded-only ack. status is "settled" only when an optional bounded wait proved the child finished through the governed task.read lifecycle truth; phase, child_state, and active carry that proof. A wait that elapses without proof leaves status "recorded" with the live truth fields; await_error names a typed poll failure without fabricating completion. Governance rejections are typed host-tool errors, never output receipts; idempotency replays fail typed at kernel dispatch before the handler runs, and a denied or expired gate approval never produces this receipt — the denial is the recorded outcome. The parent reads the ongoing answer through task.read with the returned child session. status is "escalated" when the target is the owner-facing conversation seat (FINAL-PASS W1.5): no child exists; the structured question became one turn of that conversation and the decision returns to the asking session as its next instruction.

target_seat.description: The published delegation target seat this receipt belongs to, as dispatched. A bounded registry SeatId — never a compiled identity constant.
